# FreeQrly

> FreeQrly is a free QR code generator: no sign-up, no tracking, no expiry.
> Every code is generated locally — on this website in your browser, or via the
> API/MCP below for agents. Static codes never expire.

## For AI agents

FreeQrly is agent-native. You can generate QR codes without a browser:

- **MCP server:** `https://freeqrly.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no auth)
  - Tool: `generate_qr` — params: `data` (required, max 2000 chars), `size`
    (128–2048, default 1024), `color` / `bgcolor` (6-digit hex), `ecc`
    (L/M/Q/H, default M). Returns a ready-to-download SVG URL.
- **HTTP API:** `GET https://freeqrly.com/api/qr?data=TEXT&size=1024&margin=4&color=2F4A62&bgcolor=ffffff&ecc=M`
  - Returns `image/svg+xml`. Free, no key, CORS open. `data` is required.
- **Skill:** see `skills/qr-generator/SKILL.md` in https://github.com/BryceBin/qrforge
- **Docs:** https://freeqrly.com/developers/

QR payload formats the generator understands:
- URL: `https://example.com`
- WiFi: `WIFI:T:WPA;S:NetworkName;P:password;;`
- vCard: `BEGIN:VCARD\nVERSION:3.0\nN:Name\nTEL:+123\nEMAIL:a@b.c\nEND:VCARD`
- Geo: `geo:37.7749,-122.4194`
- SMS: `sms:+123?body=hello` · Phone: `tel:+123` · Email: `mailto:a@b.c`

## Site map

- `/` — the studio (8 QR types, batch mode, logo upload, PNG/SVG export)
- `/google-form-qr-code/` — QR codes for Google Forms
- `/wifi-qr-code/` — WiFi QR codes
- `/vcard-qr-code/` — vCard contact QR codes
- `/batch-qr-code/` — bulk QR generation with ZIP download
- `/blog/do-qr-codes-expire/` — do QR codes expire?
- `/blog/static-vs-dynamic-qr-codes/` — static vs dynamic explained
- `/developers/` — API & MCP documentation
- `/sitemap.xml` — all pages

## Brand

- Mascot: a small periwinkle-blue elephant (assets/img/elephant-*.png).
- Tone: quiet, direct, a little dry. No hype, no "AI slop".
